summary: The agent correctly identifies the task as a regression problem and applies a LightGBM model. However, the solution fails to execute due to a fatal KeyError when attempting to drop the non-existent target column from the test set. Additionally, the script suffers from a lack of internal validation, applies no feature engineering, sets up brittle categorical encoding that will crash on unseen test labels, and improperly uses test set statistics to impute test data.
